Image3 approved crisp hand-painted Q style. Image4 previous phase for consistent proportions, camera and clothing, not for copying the pose. Preserve purple hair lotus crown, lilac-white-gold embroidered costume, short chibi limbs and boots, same long purple-gold qin. Facing northwest toward upper-left away from camera, back-left three-quarter view. Anatomical LEFT is near side on screen-left, RIGHT far side screen-right. Near LEFT forearm supports elevated qin neck at screen-left, far RIGHT hand on lower strings hidden behind torso. No front face.
CRITICAL POSE: RIGHT FAR FOOT CONTACT after08. Keep small FAR RIGHT front boot on IMAGE LEFT, lower it to native x495y1180, its whole sole is nearly HORIZONTAL and viewed from outer side, heel first bears weight. Right far shin extends from partly occluded far hip down to this low small shoe. NEAR LEFT foreground thigh crosses in front at hips and bends back; LARGE LEFT shoe must be HIGH native x775y980 with heel almost at backside and visible sole. Emphasize actual asymmetric anatomy: large foreground LEFT thigh/folded calf and high boot in front of far-right supporting thigh; small far RIGHT low shoe. Do not create extra crossed legs, keep exactly2. Upper body descends slightly through supporting right knee softness, same size. Near left arm continuously connected to high qin neck.
Keep anatomical LEFT hand on upper qin neck and RIGHT hand on lower strings. All body parts attached with credible shoulder-elbow-wrist and hip-knee-ankle chains. No mirrors. Fixed camera and global scale, crown around125 and virtual root512,942 on virtual1024 canvas; natural body bob without changing body proportions. Maintain image4 head size. Transparent backdrop, no floor, no shadow, no text, no VFX, no contact sheet, exactly one character. Highest visual finish.
